questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Try not to let the school fill too much. The reputation of the school doesn't mean that you should take as many courses as possible. The courses are not all that informative.

2. Check if you can get the Novo Nordisk scholarship. 

3. Say yes to live at woko if you dont wont to spend too much on housing.
